Dana, I replied in the #north-team thread. There is no single settled seat count in the records.

- Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, sets 230 seats effective 2027-01-01.
- The 2026 Renewal Order Form, signed 2026-03-20, doesn't state a seat count.
- Ilse's 261 note from 2026-10-14 has no supporting document I can find.

Please confirm the figure with Ilse or June Osei-Lark before it goes in the tracker. I also posted a correction: I wrongly said Ilse's note was from today, when it was posted on 2026-10-14.
